pin1.critical_note: LOW forces serial boot via XFWE (cuts off Q7514 TX). Keep Hi-Z for normal TX and NEVER power the Pico through this pin.

pin3.signal_name: UART TX -> AM34 RX via Q7514
pin3.critical_note: 10kΩ R7570 pull-up to NSW5V. Requires SW_UART=Hi-Z so Q7514 conducts toward AM34 SoC.

pin4.critical_note: Service manual P7501 B6B-ZR-3R4 = PIN 4 (0.0V common reference). Always verify 0.0Ω continuity before powering on.

pin5.critical_note: CRITICAL: On DMR-EH55 P7501 Pin 5 is the NSW5V rail (from IC1506 ~5.15V via D7510). ALWAYS keep as Hi-Z Input with no pulls — NEVER drive push-pull!

pin6.critical_note: Only active UART TX line observed on DMR-EH55 P7501 (10kΩ R7572 pull-up to NSW5V).

mode0.label: Mode 0: Normal Hi-Z (SW_UART Open)
mode0.description: Keeps SW_UART (GP26) in Hi-Z during XRESET open-drain pulse; Q7514 stays conducting UARTM2P_T -> AM34.

mode1.label: Mode 1: Serial Pulse (XFWE Pre-Reset)
mode1.description: Pulses SW_UART LOW only across XRESET release, then restores GP26 to Hi-Z to enable bidirectional TX after handshake.
mode1.signal_diagram: SW_UART: Pulse Low -> Hi-Z | Q7514 Re-enabled

mode2.label: Mode 2: JIG Hold LOW (SW_UART Latched)
mode2.description: Standard JIGBOOT mode for AM34 UART capture: holds SW_UART LOW via Q7510 across boot window before returning to Hi-Z.
mode2.signal_diagram: SW_UART: Hold Low -> Isolate Hi-Z | 115200 8N1 RX

mode3.label: Mode 3: Extended Hi-Z (Long Capture)
mode3.description: Performs open-drain XRESET pulse while keeping UART lines in Hi-Z listen mode for full CDDIAG and DDR CHECK traces.
mode3.signal_diagram: XRESET: Open-Drain | GP2 RX + GP3 NSW5V Hi-Z

mb2.chip_name: Spansion S29AL016J NOR Flash (2 MB / 16 Mbit)

mb4.chip_name: Spansion S29JL032H NOR Flash (4 MB / 32 Mbit)

mb8.chip_name: Spansion S29JL064H NOR Flash (8 MB / 64 Mbit)

mb16.chip_name: Spansion S29GL128P NOR Flash (16 MB / 128 Mbit)

PINCHECK.label: Electrical Matrix (PINCHECK)
PINCHECK.description: Audits all 6 pins on P7501 across Hi-Z, Pull-Down, and Pull-Up states plus XRESET rise time.

BUSDIAG.label: Contention & Boot (BUSDIAG)
BUSDIAG.description: Sweeps GP4/UARTM2P_T drive strengths (2..12 mA) and compares GP2 UART RX profiles with SW_UART Hi-Z vs LOW.

SNIFF.label: Passive Monitor (SNIFF)
SNIFF.description: Counts passive edge transitions on GP2..GP5 over a configurable sampling window (ms).

ISOLATE.label: Isolate Bus (Hi-Z)
ISOLATE.description: Switches GP2..GP5 to high impedance so probe lines do not load normal DMR-EH55 boot.

ENGAGE.label: Engage UART / PIO
ENGAGE.description: Activates 3.3V P7501 PIO / UART signaling while holding NSW5V (GP3) strictly in Hi-Z.

RESET.label: Open-Drain XRESET Pulse
RESET.description: Pulls XRESET to 0V in open-drain mode for 10 ms and releases back to Hi-Z.

IDENTIFY.label: Identify Target (4-Stage)
IDENTIFY.description: Runs 4-stage target identification (ADC0/NSW5V, loader banner, JEDEC/IPL CRC32) and emits @P7501_IDENT.

BREAK_IN.label: Boot/Reset Profile
BREAK_IN.description: Applies discrete P7501 boot/reset profile (modes 0..3: Hi-Z, Serial Pulse, JIG Hold LOW, Extended).

JOB.label: Atomic On-Probe Job
JOB.description: Executes atomic on-probe job with mandatory pre-backup to P2_VAULT (STATUS, VAULT_BACKUP, NVRAM_CLEAN, BGO_APPLY).

AUTODETECT.label: Autodetect Flash (Read-Only)
AUTODETECT.description: Measures passive address aliasing (2/4/8/16 MB) without writing to NOR Flash.

CFI.label: JEDEC CFI Query
CFI.description: Issues JEDEC 0x98 CFI query (Spansion QRY signature and 2^N geometry exponent).

FLASH_SIZE.label: Set Flash Geometry
FLASH_SIZE.description: Overrides expected NOR Flash capacity used for memory reads and GDB RSP XML maps.

DUMP.label: Memory Dump
DUMP.description: Reads 32-bit little-endian words from arbitrary AM34 SRAM, NOR Flash, or MMIO addresses.

BOOTCAP.label: Capture UART Boot (BOOTCAP)
BOOTCAP.description: Resets recorder and captures 115200 8N1 telemetry on GP2 during the configured window.

UARTMON.label: Passive UART Monitor
UARTMON.description: Listens passively on GP2 115200 8N1 without asserting XRESET on the recorder.

JIGBOOT.label: Jig Mode Boot (JIGBOOT)
JIGBOOT.description: Boots target SoC while holding SW_UART LOW across the capture window.

JIGPIN.label: Software TW7501 Strap (JIGPIN)
JIGPIN.description: Latches SW_UART (GP26 / TW7501) LOW or releases to Hi-Z ADC0 without pulsing XRESET.

BAUD.label: PIO1 UART Baud Rate
BAUD.description: Configures or queries PIO1 RX/TX state machine baud rate on SC0 (AM34 default: 115200 bps).

BAUDSCAN.label: Sweep & Auto-Baud Boot
BAUDSCAN.description: Resets target via XRESET, measures real baud on GP2 and captures initial samples (optional APPLY).

UARTSTREAM.label: Zero-Drop PIO1 UART Stream
UARTSTREAM.description: Captures 115200 8N1 streaming on PIO1 with zero byte drop during boot and supports JIG:<hold_ms>.

HEXCAP.label: PIO1 Hex/Break Capture
HEXCAP.description: Displays raw UART stream in hex + ASCII with line break markers via PIO1.

UARTTXHEX.label: Deterministic Hex TX (PIO1)
UARTTXHEX.description: Transmits hexadecimal sequence (or BRK) on GP4 with PIO1 timing and captures response on GP2.

WAITTX.label: Deterministic Trigger & TX
WAITTX.description: Monitors boot stream until ASCII trigger is detected (e.g. wait 1) and injects hex payload or Break with optional Q7514 release.

PWRTRACE.label: Dual ADC0 + UART Profiler
PWRTRACE.description: Logs GP2/GP3 transitions and ADC0 (GP26) voltage alongside PIO1 UART stream to correlate rails with boot.

BOOTTRACE.label: Correlated Boot Profiler
BOOTTRACE.description: Fuses timestamped PIO1 UART lines, GP3/GP4/GP5 control-pin edge events without GP2 overflow, and GP26 ADC0 rail monitoring.

BOOTFOLLOW.label: Passive Continuous Boot Follower
BOOTFOLLOW.description: Passively monitors PIO1 UART boot stream without driving XRESET/SW_UART and resets relative clock on real target boot cycles.

FRAMING.label: PIO1 UART Framing (8N1/8E1/8O1)
FRAMING.description: Queries or configures hardware-timed parity framing (zero extra PIO slots) on PIO1 RX/TX state machines.

PIOLOGIC.label: 4-Ch PIO0 Logic Edge Sampler
PIOLOGIC.description: Captures simultaneous GP2/GP3/GP4/GP5 edges on PIO0 (up to 2 MHz) with optional CTRL filter while keeping GP3 NSW5V strictly Hi-Z.

SDSNIFF.label: Passive PIO0 SD Sniffer (GP10..15)
SDSNIFF.description: Captures passive Hi-Z SD bus lines (GP10=CLK, GP11=CMD, GP12..15=DAT0..3), decoding CMD55/ACMD6/ACMD13, CMD17/CMD18 LBAs, and per-lane CRC16.

JIGSWEEP.label: SW_UART Latch & Pre-DDR Sweep
JIGSWEEP.description: Maps exact P50 hardware latch window (HOLD/DELAY) and probes 0..10ms pre-DDR boot handshakes (8E1 AMOBP / BREAK / ESC).

PANARSP.label: PANA_RSP Client Probe (MAIN)
PANARSP.description: Probes MAIN _dev_SERIAL RSP stub (FUN_574f0590/0775) via PIO1 (G/Z0/Z1/MEM/XMEM/WMEM/WRITE32/PASSTHROUGH/DUMPNOR/CALL).

DIAGWATCH.label: Autonomous Boot Watchdog (DIAGWATCH)
DIAGWATCH.description: Monitors SC0 stream, releases SW_UART on serial boot (JIG) or DDR CHECK: OK (NORMAL), classifies SDDIAG/CDDIAG/BGO failures, and dispatches B/R/W/F/D/J/E/Q on PANAMON1>.

IRTX.label: 38 kHz Kaseikyo IR Synthesizer (IRTX)
IRTX.description: Transmits Panasonic Kaseikyo 38 kHz IR frames (Teletext RED, SERV, ND2 5+9+RED, POWER, AUDIO) via an IR LED on a safe spare GPIO.

DRVPANA.label: Drive Optical Serial CLI (DRVPANA)
DRVPANA.description: Sends F/E Factory CLI commands to Matshita R6-MV4 via PIO1 with automatic PASS 0x4d415453 0x48495441 unlock and RX capture.

BRIDGE.label: Transparent UART Bridge
BRIDGE.description: Enters bidirectional USB CDC <-> P7501 SC0 passthrough mode (exit by sending '~~~').

FMUSCAN.label: FMU Bootrom Sweep (FMUSCAN)
FMUSCAN.description: Sweeps Panasonic Bootrom FMU handshake sequences across Wait/Serial windows.

FMUTEST.label: Inject FMU Hex Payload
FMUTEST.description: Sends arbitrary hex payload during SW_UART FMU handshake and records target echo.

FMUBATCH.label: FMU Multi-Command Batch
FMUBATCH.description: Runs automated Bootrom FMU handshake probes in controlled sequence.

UARTSEND.label: Send TX String P7501
UARTSEND.description: Sends ASCII + CRLF with SW_UART=Hi-Z default (Q7514 enabled) or LOW: prefix and captures 2.5s RX reply.

UARTPROBE.label: Interactive UART Probe
UARTPROBE.description: Tests stimulus modes 0..8 during boot to discover hidden UART/BREAK consoles.

PING.label: Ping USB CDC / BLE
PING.description: Verifies immediate responsiveness of the Pico firmware CLI layer.

STATUS.label: Read VDD/ADC Telemetry
STATUS.description: Samples target voltage on ADC0 (GP26) with active floating-pin detection.

BANNER.label: Firmware Version & Banner
BANNER.description: Displays full RP2040/RP2350 firmware build banner running on the probe.

WDT.label: Hardware Watchdog (WDT)
WDT.description: Audits the non-overridable 4000ms hardware watchdog, recovery counter, boot source, and last command latency.

LED.label: Onboard LED GP25 Mode
LED.description: Switches visual blink pattern on the Pico onboard LED (with manual polling lock) or restores AUTO.

BOOTSEL.label: Reboot to USB BOOTSEL
BOOTSEL.description: Reboots the Pico probe into USB Mass Storage bootloader (`RPI-RP2` / `RP2350`).

SELFTEST.label: Probe Hardware Self-Test
SELFTEST.description: Validates electrical invariants (GP3 NSW5V Hi-Z, ADC0, PIO0/PIO1, WDT, P0 CRC32) and optional GP4->GP2 loopback on the probe.

TARGET_PROFILE.label: DIGA Target Profile
TARGET_PROFILE.description: Selects the SSOT DIGA target profile (DMR-EH55, DMR-ES35V, DMR-EZ485V, DMR-ES10) and RO locks.

VAULT.label: QSPI Forensic Vault (P2)
VAULT.description: Manages forensic NVRAM backup slots in the P2_VAULT A/B partition of Pico QSPI Flash.

BLACKBOX.label: QSPI Flight Blackbox (P4)
BLACKBOX.description: Inspects or appends wear-leveled telemetry records (48 x 4 KiB pages) in P4_BLACKBOX.

PROBE_CFG.label: Calibration & Config (P5)
PROBE_CFG.description: Queries or calibrates integer ADC0 gain/offset and SSOT hash in P5_PROBE_CFG A/B banks.

RECIPE.label: Signed Repair Recipes (P3)
RECIPE.description: Verifies header and CRC32 of repair recipes stored in P3_RECIPE.

BGO_INSPECT.label: Inspect BGO [nfrom] FTL
BGO_INSPECT.description: Audits BGO sector headers (SA26..SA70) and detects duplicate or corrupted LBNs.

EEMUL_INSPECT.label: Inspect EEMUL NVRAM
EEMUL_INSPECT.description: Analyzes wear and health of 8 KB EEMUL micro-sectors at the top of NOR Flash.

IRRX.label: Decode Kaseikyo IR
IRRX.description: Captures and decodes 48-bit Panasonic Kaseikyo infrared frames on a safe spare GPIO.

SERVMACRO.label: Service Mode IR Macro
SERVMACRO.description: Transmits verified service IR macro sequence (SERVICE_MODE, SELF_CHECK, OPTICAL_CAL, ERR_HISTORY, RELEASE).

MMIO_SNAP.label: Multi-Domain MMIO Snapshot
MMIO_SNAP.description: Reads and decodes safe AM34 diagnostic registers by domain (CORE/VIDEO/STORAGE/ALL/DIFF), strictly excluding 0xC000100C and 0xDC0F0000.

PWROSC.label: VDD Ripple & Die Temp
PWROSC.description: Samples millivolt ripple on SW_UART/ADC0 and internal RP2 silicon die temperature.

TBUSSNIFF.label: IC7501 T-BUS Sniffer
TBUSSNIFF.description: Decodes passive T-BUS protocol frames between Timer MCU IC7501 and AM34.

M0KEEPALIVE.label: Timer MCU M0 Keepalive
M0KEEPALIVE.description: Controls periodic T-BUS keepalive frames (ON [ms] / OFF / STATUS) to prevent 44s IC7501 watchdog power-down on the bench.

I2C_SCAN.label: 3.3V I2C Scanner (GP6/GP7)
I2C_SCAN.description: Scans 3.3V I2C bus and matches 0x50..0x57 addresses against the SSOT EEPROM catalog.

EEPROM.label: SSOT I2C EEPROM Access
EEPROM.description: Queries catalog, reads, or writes 3.3V I2C EEPROM pages with strict boundary checks.

USBMODE.label: USB Dual-CDC Mode
USBMODE.description: Switches or queries passive UART stream mirroring on the second CDC channel (SINGLE / DUAL_CDC).

BLE.label: BLE / Wi-Fi Radio Status
BLE.description: Displays CYW43439 radio state (BLE NUS / TCP :3333 GDB) and F14 NOR write lock.

BLE_NOR_AUTH.label: Authorize BLE NOR Write (F14)
BLE_NOR_AUTH.description: Grants or revokes (strictly from physical USB) temporary NOR write permission for wireless sessions.

NOR_MAP.label: Full 142-Sector NOR Map
NOR_MAP.description: Scans all 142 physical IC5001 sectors (SA0..SA141) on-probe, streaming live @P7501_PROG telemetry.

FAST_READ.label: Fast Binary Read (0x9043A000 Stub)
FAST_READ.description: Uploads the 606 B MN103S binary stub from Pico and streams 256 B bitmap/sum8 pages with @P7501_PROG.

FAST_WRITE.label: Fast Guarded BGO Write (1->0 JEDEC)
FAST_WRITE.description: Pre-validates 1->0 monotonicity on-probe before unlocking Upper NOR, programs via 0x9043A000 stub, and relocks via U LOCK.

HOTPLUG.label: Hotplug Monitor & NSW5V Auto-Heal
HOTPLUG.description: Toggles automatic @P7501_FRAME HOTPLUG push events and reports debounced NSW5V/LED recovery counters.

LIVE_MAP.label: Deterministic Live Hardware Map
LIVE_MAP.description: Captures rail electricals, CORE/VIDEO/STORAGE MMIO domains, IC3001 map, NOR/BGO headers, and UART into CRC32 push frames.

STREAM.label: SRAM Push-Frame Bus
STREAM.description: Queries 4 KiB SRAM push-ring telemetry (@P7501_FRAME), triggers a CRC32 test flush, or resets counters.

TRAP.label: Hardware Trap Auditor
TRAP.description: Lists or checks SSOT trap ranges (0xC000100C, 0xDC0F0000, IPL SA0..SA10, CS0 mirrors, 0x84200000 vs 0x84130000).

PAYLOAD.label: On-Probe Ready Payload Catalog
PAYLOAD.description: Lists, verifies CRC32 integrity, or executes embedded probe payloads (video_mmio_dump, tbc_passthrough, fast_bgo_stream, jedec).

SECTOR.label: Sector Locator & Safe Patcher
SECTOR.description: Resolves SA0..SA141 geometry, scans NOR signatures/Feistel keys, and patches bytes with 1->0, pre-image, and E05 guards.

CRYPTO.label: 64-bit Feistel & Adler-32 Engine
CRYPTO.description: Runs Matsushita 64-bit Feistel crypt, 12-key SSOT autodetection, and strided/RFC1950 Adler-32 on-probe.

DECOMP.label: Okumura LZSS & zlib/DEFLATE Engine
DECOMP.description: Decompresses Okumura LZSS (0x0FEE) and zlib/DEFLATE (stored/fixed/dynamic) payloads in SRAM arena with zero malloc.

GPS.label: PiE-OS Mathematical Compass & GPS
GPS.description: Calibrates PiE-OS anchors via live affine shift, computes fixed-point Shannon entropy, and decodes MN103S prologues/CALLs/MMIO.

ROUTE.label: Deterministic Domain Route Planner
ROUTE.description: Synthesizes calibrated VA routes, payloads, trap guards, and next actions across BOOT, VIDEO, BGO, HDD, NVRAM, and UNBRICK.

XRAY.label: 12-Stage PiE-OS Boot Metabolism X-Ray
XRAY.description: Traces 12-stage PiE-OS boot telemetry on Pico with millisecond timestamps, deltas, call-chain attribution, and optional ANSI log colors.

SURG.label: Live Runtime Microsurgeon & Time-Travel (SDRAM)
SURG.description: Wildcard search, MN103S disassembler, bitwise algebra, in-place timeout/hook injection, live pause/jump, and undo/redo in SDRAM.
